step.cmd: In FTS, using the old SIN, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the registration number assigned to the initial application with the old SIN.
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the request for a SIN change.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 34 - Social insurance number change .
Remarks line 1: Type “SIN change to new SIN [new SIN].”

Remarks line 2 to 4: Enter the appropriate options:
The list of all BPCs with the old SIN.
If a D15 is imposed from the BPC under the 900-series SIN for the same BPC that will be established with the permanent SIN and the D15 is not required for the permanent SIN, type “Do not transfer BPC [XXXX] from old SIN. BPC [XXXX] is on new SIN.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the registration number assigned to the initial application with the old SIN.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Determine if there is a WI related to the SIN change that was not deleted:

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
